QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] The Unexpected Problem
QuestInfo.1: #p2152004# offers you a used Oxygen Respirator that looks like it was thrown away by someone. She says it will be enough for #p2152005#... You can't imagine how a doctor could do something so unsanitary. Go see #b#p2152005##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p2152005# was about to equip the #t4032763#, until he discovered something shocking. With the bear head taking up so much space, equipping an Oxygen Respirator was impossible! In retrospect, #p2152004# was wise in her decision...

0.0: The Oxygen Respirator should be here...
0.1: #b(Claudine takes out a Oxygen Respirator from a plastic bag and hands it to you. It appears to have been thrown away.)#k
0.2: This should be sufficient--no, MORE than sufficient--for Checky. And don't be concerned that it's unsanitary. Checky won't be able to use it anyway.

yes.0: In any case, #bChecky#k will want this. Please bring it to him.

no.0: You don't need to worry... I already know what Checky is going to do with this.

1.0: The Oxygen Respirator is finally here! Finally! I just need to put it on and... OH NO!

yes.0: #b(It's an #t4032763# made to fit a human face. It's impossible for #p2152005# to put it on with his bear costume on. #p2152005# seems shocked. The bear head's expression seems dopier than usual...)#k

npc.0: Have you not gone to #b#p2152005##k yet? I'm glad that you're a nice person but you really don't need to worry about him too much.

item.0: Have you not brought the #t4032763#? Ugh... I can't breathe! Please hurry to #b#p2152004##k.
